risks.title: Identity platform coupling to national federation roadmap
risks.mitigation: Adopt the identity platform as the single authority; keep federation adapters behind interfaces.

risks.title: Offline-first sync conflicts across governorate partitions
risks.mitigation: Outbox pattern + conflict-resolution policies exercised in pilot.

risks.title: Governorate data residency and national aggregation conflict
risks.mitigation: Tenant-aware routing and regional data stores planned for 3-year horizon.

risks.title: Analyzer protocol fragmentation across laboratory hardware
risks.mitigation: Standardize ASTM/HL7 device bridge with validation per result.

risks.title: Database and storage growth at national scale
risks.mitigation: Partition data stores, add read replicas, and archive per retention policy before hitting capacity limits.

risks.title: ISO 15189 / CAP / CLSI audit evidence drift
risks.mitigation: Automate evidence packs in quality gates; continuous validation.

risks.title: ENCRYPTION_KEY rotation without bulk re-encryption
risks.mitigation: Design key rotation with per-record key versioning and lazy re-encryption.

risks.title: Cloud snapshot restore path is not rehearsed
risks.mitigation: Rehearse restore runbook; verify PITR + WAL recovery end-to-end.

risks.title: AI engines drift from the single architectural vision
risks.mitigation: The Architect coordinates all six engines; contracts and registers are the single source of truth.

risks.title: Knowledge coverage lags behind architectural change
risks.mitigation: Learner records knowledge per mission; brain freshness is a hard CI gate.
